pages.text: It had rained hard last night. The grass had all fallen to one side, making a new path.
"What's at the end?" "Let's see!" They stood side by side at the path's entrance.
The path was very narrow. Their shoulders brushed the grass when they stood together. Who would go first?
"You go first." Taro pushed Mumu's back.
"No, you go first." Mumu pushed Taro's back.
They pushed each other. Their feet moved back and forth, but neither entered the path.
The sun sank lower, and their shadows grew long. They still stood at the entrance.
Taro suddenly let go. "We can go sideways!"
They pressed their shoulders together and just fitted into the narrow path. Grass bent aside, making it a little wider.
And what was at the end? The well where they fetched water every day. Still shoulder to shoulder, they laughed.
